text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf, the student council doesn't<n>need you today.
No sitting in your<n>usual chair.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You left out all the context, Brian!<n>Good grief... Sorry
about that,<n>President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Any council work that needs doing<n>today, Brian and
I can take care of. So<n>please, take the day off to
relax.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Haha! I see, very well then. You had<n>me worried
for a second there. I<n>thought I was being ejected
from the<n>student council.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But then again... Well, hm. Though I<n>appreciate the
sentiment...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I would like to pop into the officenow and then—feel free to pretendI'm not there. You wouldn't mind that,would you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Already getting lonely? Some<n>"emperor" you
are.
